audit.why: The content layer's read is right: Levels 1-3 are his on H-28 G Evolution Turret zoning plus Hextech Micro-Rockets poke, Levels 4-5 stabilise once Thunderclap and Ground Slam are up, Level 6 is the swing. That matches the 55.39% Malphite win rate over 408 games — Malphite is favoured overall but loses the first three levels.
audit.corrected: Kept. Only added the real ability names and the cooldowns that make the stages actionable.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes never carry a cooldown, so 'hold R for when he is caught forward' has no clock attached, and the first-item spike says to buy a 'small MR item' without naming why armour is dead here.
audit.why: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade is a flat 11s at every rank and Hextech Micro-Rockets is 11/10/9/8/7s — those two numbers define the poke rhythm. UPGRADE!!! (100/85/70s) empowers his next spell, so his level-6 spike is a bigger grenade, not new damage. Unstoppable Force is 130/115/100s.
audit.corrected: Spikes now name UPGRADE!!! and the 11s grenade so the level-6 trade has a real clock.

audit.why: I checked the page's central claim rather than assuming it. Unstoppable Force dashes with displacement immunity and the League Wiki ability note states the dash 'cannot be deterred by crowd control' — so the content layer is RIGHT that R goes through CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade once it is airborne. The FULL layer contradicts this: it lists 'Eat his E stun' as a critical don't, tells you to 'engage only on CH-2 Grenade's cooldown', and calls the grenade matchup-defining. The true nuance is that the grenade only beats you BEFORE the cast — it cannot stop the dash after it starts.
audit.corrected: Full layer brought in line with the content layer: grenade denies the wind-up, never the airborne R.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet flags 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere' — confirmed, zero numbers in either layer.
audit.why: His punishable window is the 11s grenade: it is his only self-peel and it does not scale down with rank, so it is the same 11s at level 3 and level 18.
audit.corrected: Added the 11s grenade and 11/10/9/8/7s rockets as the commit clock.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization reads 'Iceborn Gauntlet / Frozen Heart (by his AD profile), then Thornmail' against a champion who deals pure magic damage, while the page's own TL;DR says build MR.
audit.why: Every damage source in his kit — turret beams, Hextech Micro-Rockets, CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade — is magic. Armour and Thornmail contribute nothing, though Ground Slam scaling off armour means the trade-off is worth stating rather than ignoring.
audit.corrected: MR core, and the note that Ground Slam still wants some armour so the choice is deliberate.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet flags that neither layer ever names his abilities — they say 'his turrets', 'W rocket storm', 'E stun-grenade'. The full layer invents the short form 'CH-2 Grenade'.
audit.why: The real names are Hextech Affinity, H-28 G Evolution Turret, Hextech Micro-Rockets, CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade and UPGRADE!!!. Hextech Affinity in particular is never mentioned and it is why he outruns you near his turrets and tower.
audit.corrected: Real names used, and Hextech Affinity's move speed added as the reason he escapes ganks under his own nest.

edits.after: His threat window: three H-28 G turrets plus Hextech Micro-Rockets wall me off the wave and chunk me before I have W/E.

edits.after: Lay three H-28 G Evolution Turrets to zone the wave and wall my melee Thunderclap autos off it

edits.after: Poke me down with Hextech Micro-Rockets every 11s so I never stabilize before Level 6

edits.after: Land CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade to stun me before I can even cast Unstoppable Force

edits.before: Levels 4-5 finally stabilize me: with Thunderclap (W) granting armor and empowering my autos with AoE splash, and Ground Slam (E) up, my Granite Shield refreshes between rocket volleys and I can clear his turrets and farm through the poke instead of being walled off. Level 6 is the swing — Unstoppable Force (R) is unstoppable, so it eats his E stun-grenade mid-dash and knocks him clean out of his turret nest, which is the one thing that flips this lane. Bait his E grenade first if you can, but even into it the R lands; just hold it for when he is caught forward, not hiding behind a full turret wall.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 finally stabilize me: with Thunderclap (W) granting armor and empowering my autos with AoE splash, and Ground Slam (E) up, my Granite Shield refreshes between rocket volleys and I can clear his turrets and farm through the poke instead of being walled off. Level 6 is the swing — Unstoppable Force dashes with displacement immunity, so CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade cannot deter it once it is airborne and I knock him clean out of his nest. The catch is the wind-up: an 11s grenade landing BEFORE the cast stuns me and the R never happens. Bait it, then press R while it is down.

edits.before: It's a coin-flip at 6: your Unstoppable Force ignores his stun-grenade and knocks him out of the nest, but a well-placed turret wall and E can still deny the dash.
edits.after: Your Unstoppable Force dashes displacement-immune, so his 11s grenade cannot deter it mid-flight — but it stuns you before the cast, so bait the grenade first.

edits.before: This is where I take over. His turrets and W poke do nothing in a teamfight once I am armor-stacked, and my Unstoppable Force (R) flanks his squishy AP body or opens onto his whole side before he can E-stun me out of the dash. A fed Heimerdinger can still zone a chokepoint with turrets and one-shot me with a charged W if I facecheck alone, so don't solo-dive his nest — group, let my R knock him up into my team, and his entire kit collapses the moment he has no walls to hide behind.
edits.after: This is where I take over. His turrets and rocket poke do nothing in a teamfight once I am stacked, and Unstoppable Force flanks his squishy body displacement-immune — CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade cannot deter the dash once airborne. A fed Heimerdinger still zones a chokepoint with turrets and one-shots me with an UPGRADE!!! grenade if I facecheck alone, and Hextech Affinity speeds him up near his turrets, so don't solo-dive the nest — group, let my R knock him into my team.

edits.after: - CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade: a flat 11s at every rank — his only self-peel, and it stops your R only before the cast. - Hextech Micro-Rockets 11/10/9/8/7s is the poke clock. - Unstoppable Force 130/115/100s: kill windows only.

notes: I web-verified the page's central claim rather than assuming it, because it appears four times: League Wiki states Unstoppable Force dashes with displacement immunity and that the dash 'cannot be deterred by crowd control'. The CONTENT layer was right and the FULL layer was wrong — full listed 'Eat his E stun' as a critical don't and told you to engage only on the grenade cooldown. Both now say the same thing, with the real nuance that the grenade beats the cast but not the airborne dash. Same wiki page confirms Malphite's Q applies a slow and E applies a cripple (attack-speed reduction), NOT grounding — the kit file's 'grounding' derived flag on both Q and E is a tooltip-parsing misfire and I asserted it nowhere. The 'projectile' flag on R is likewise a misfire; R is a location dash. Full-layer boilerplate not fixed here: tradeGood/dosFull[1].d describe generic 'Q on his last-hits, E his attack speed' text that is duplicated verbatim across many Malphite matchups and refers to Heimerdinger as 'his/he' throughout — a champion-level template issue, not a matchup fact.
